title: Google Config Connector operator
description: The Google Config Connector operator and its cluster-scoped ConfigConnector CR.

image.title: Operator image
image.description: Container image for the Config Connector operator.

enabled.title: Create the ConfigConnector CR
enabled.description: When false, installs the operator only and creates no ConfigConnector.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: cluster uses one Google service account for the whole cluster. namespaced uses a ConfigConnectorContext per namespace and requires Workload Identity.

credentialSecretName.title: Credential Secret name
credentialSecretName.description: Secret holding the Google service-account key. Cluster mode only, and mutually exclusive with googleServiceAccount.

googleServiceAccount.title: Workload Identity service account
googleServiceAccount.description: Google service account to impersonate via Workload Identity. Mutually exclusive with credentialSecretName.
